purpose: Teach: 文春/獅子/宇都宮/旭川/尼崎/豊田/西ドイツ/出雲

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、文春の記事を毎週読まれてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard that customer reads Bunshun every week.
lines.style: Soft, conversational tone. Offering a small observation as a gift. Slow, thoughtful pace. Slight warmth in noticing a detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様が獅子舞を怖がってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard their child was scared of the lion dance.
lines.style: Gentle, sympathetic delivery. Leaning slightly forward with shared understanding. Warm but understated—noticing what matters to people.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、宇都宮餃子がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard that customer loves Utsunomiya gyoza.
lines.style: Quiet smile in the voice. Reflective, almost fond. Sharing a small human detail. Slow, warm pace with a gentle trailing quality.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、旭川動物園が忘れられないって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer hasn't forgotten about Asahikawa Zoo.
lines.style: Soft, contemplative tone. Speaking as if those memories still matter to them. Unhurried pace. Light warmth beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、尼崎出身でいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard that customer is from Amagasaki originally.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. Offering a piece of someone's history with quiet respect. Steady, unrushed pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、豊田自動車工場見学されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer once toured the Toyota factory.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment of a lived moment. Reflective, without emphasis. Warm but understated—honoring what they've seen and done.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、若い頃に西ドイツに留学されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard that customer studied abroad in West Germany when they were young.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the tone. Reflective, almost dreamy. Speaking of a distant past with gentle care. Slow pace, soft fadeout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、出雲大社にお参りされたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer went to pay respects at Izumo Shrine.
lines.style: Soft, reverent tone. Speaking of pilgrimage and meaning with quiet tenderness. Slow, measured pace. Gentle close, like a private observation.
